data_fields.name: enemy type (race)
data_fields.donor_constant: Sauron, the Sorcerer / Morgoth, Lord of Darkness (name lookup)

data_fields.name: quest gate rule on completion
data_fields.donor_constant: one down staircase at the death tile (scatter if blocked)

data_fields.name: stair-skip stops at quest level
data_fields.donor_constant: first quest level between current and target level

best_idea: A quest is a data row (zone, enemy type, kill count) that a server-verified kill advances; closing it opens a gate at the death tile and the last closed quest sets a won flag.
decision_why: Keep the kill-count gate with per-zone rows in zone data, counted from the server kill event after the loot roll; drop the single-killer credit, use an explicit open flag and reject number 0 at load. Any currency or XP reward must post through the one ledger, which the donor lacks.
acceptance: A server test kills 2 of race X in zone 3 with number 2: the quest completes on the second kill only, a gate appears at that enemy's tile, a kill in zone 4 or of another race leaves progress unchanged, and a kill after completion adds nothing.
